description: Stop guessing whether you're on track — know it at a glance. Canvas Bullet Chart by DataFactZ replaces bloated gauges and cluttered scorecards with a single, information-dense bar that shows performance, target, and quality context all in one view. Built for analysts and executives who need clear answers fast. Why Teams Choose This Visual Traditional bar charts show you a number. A Bullet Chart tells you a story. With color-coded performance bands and a crisp target marker, stakeholders understand instantly whether a metric is bad, satisfactory, or good — no legend required, no extra explanation needed. It's the chart Stephen Few designed for serious business reporting, now available in Power BI with enterprise-grade customization. Key Features - Three-Tier Performance Bands — Define custom thresholds for Bad, Satisfactory, and Good zones with your own colors and percentages to match your KPI logic and brand palette. - Dual Bar Rendering — An independent quality bar sits behind the performance bar for instant visual depth without clutter. Control each bar's height separately for a pixel-perfect layout. - Animated Play Axis — Connect a date or month field to the Play Axis and watch your metrics evolve period by period, with adjustable playback speed.
